body:
Step C2 of the polish-pass mandate: audit SPEC.md [x] closure claims vs actual reality. Same pattern as C1 (which audited code-composition gaps). Audit-only deliverable; no code changes.

Method: scan SPEC.md for closure-note language that implies "X works" while the underlying verification was synthetic-only or aspirational. The Slice-7 static-ball bug + the C1 Memory un-integration bug share this pattern: an [x] line whose closure prose says "end-to-end verified" referring to a synthetic execute_code injection at SPEC-closure time, NOT to natural-play observation.

Findings:

(1) SPEC line 144 — "1 MemoryEvent reader callback": closure prose claims "End-to-end Unity Mono load verified via UnityMCP execute_code: synthetic Goal KeyEvent → 1 MemoryEvent → ledger → 1 PressFanReader CallbackCandidate". This was synthetic-only at SPEC closure (2026-04-30). The actual live-loop integration was missing until C1a (commit ca46b45, 2026-05-11). NOW the natural-play chain works (verified via natural-play L2 in C1a). RECOMMENDED FIX: append a 2026-05-11 honesty update to the closure prose noting "synthetic-only at SPEC closure → C1a integrated into live loop natural play via commit ca46b45; ledger gains 2 GoalScored MemoryEvents in 50s natural smoke fixture play".

(2) SPEC line 145 — "1 persistent development event" (SignatureBreakthrough): closure prose claims "End-to-end Unity Mono load verified via UnityMCP execute_code: synthetic KeyEventKind.SignatureBreakthrough → MemoryEvent (band=Notable) → ledger → BreakthroughReader returns 1 CallbackCandidate". Same synthetic-only pattern. The natural-play chain didn't work until C1a (Memory integration) + C4 (signature triggers fire naturally). RECOMMENDED FIX: append a 2026-05-11 honesty update noting "synthetic-only at SPEC closure → C1a + C4 enabled natural-play firing via commits ca46b45 + 10efbdf; LowCutback signature fires tick 0 in primed fixture → Ledger gains MemoryEvent → (Phase-4+ UI surfaces it)".

(3) SPEC line 129 — Player state machine: closure prose said "No separate Kick API: kick = new BallState(...) is trivial composition; integration test verifies player-runs-to-ball-then-kicks loop end-to-end." Pre-pass-the-ball this was synthetic-only — the kick composition was never assembled in the live match loop. ALREADY FIXED in commit 119f76d (post-pass-the-ball SPEC sync) — closure prose now has a honesty note pointing at commit b153678. No further action needed; included here as the original instance of this pattern.

Pattern across all 3: "X is verified" claims that reflected synthetic-execute_code injection at SPEC closure, not natural-play composition. The new /duo-implement Step 4.1 rule (commit 8e2dc1b) blocks this for future commits; the historical claims need explicit honesty updates so future audits don't chase them.

acceptance:
- This audit is the deliverable. No code/SPEC changes in THIS task.
- For each P1 finding, a follow-up cycle appends an honesty update to the SPEC closure prose. Follow-up cycles can be batched into a single SPEC bookkeeping commit since they're all the same pattern.

Recommended follow-up sequence:
- C2a: SPEC honesty updates for lines 144 + 145 (single sibling commit; pattern same as line 129 update in commit 119f76d). No new code; ~30 LoC of SPEC prose appended.
- C2b: optional — author a lint rule that flags "verified via UnityMCP execute_code: synthetic" or similar phrasing in future SPEC closure prose so this pattern can't ship again. Out of scope for C2; defer to Phase-3-polish-extras.

files_in_scope:
  - (audit-only; no file modifications)

files_out_of_scope:
  - Everything (audit produces findings; follow-up cycles do the actual SPEC updates)

max_tokens: 30000
max_wall_clock_seconds: 600
max_turns: 5

implementing_agent: claude; reviewing_agent: codex (audit-only; no review cycle needed since no code changes).

depends_on: C1 audit (bb136866), C1a Memory integration (ca46b45), C4 signatures natural play (10efbdf).

C2 audit + C2a SPEC honesty updates done. 2 P1 findings (SPEC lines 144 + 145, both 'verified via UnityMCP execute_code: synthetic' pattern — same shape as the Slice-7 static-ball + kick-API bugs). C2a appended honesty updates to both closure-prose blocks naming the C1a + C4 commits that actually integrated the work into the live loop. No new tests; no [x] state changes (the work was shipped, just wishfully described). Pattern: 'verified via UnityMCP execute_code: synthetic ...' will be the lint hook target for Phase-3 polish extras. fw verify GREEN; 651/651 MatchSim; no code changes.
